description: This file contains functions and configuration logic for setting up Wi-Fi access points and WPA supplicant networks, including rate management, WEP/WPA key handling, logging, and device/BSS configuration.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_add_rate
methods.description: Calculates and appends rate values to a variable for WPA supplicant configuration.

methods.name: hostapd_add_rate
methods.description: Converts rate from bps to Mbps and appends to a variable.

methods.name: hostapd_append_wep_key
methods.description: Appends WEP keys to configuration based on key index.

methods.name: hostapd_append_wpa_key_mgmt
methods.description: Determines WPA key management protocols based on auth_type and other parameters.

methods.name: hostapd_add_log_config
methods.description: Adds logging configuration options for hostapd.

methods.name: hostapd_common_add_device_config
methods.description: Adds common device configuration options for hostapd.

methods.name: hostapd_prepare_device_config
methods.description: Prepares device-specific hostapd configuration based on parameters.

methods.name: hostapd_common_add_bss_config
methods.description: Adds common BSS configuration options for hostapd.

methods.name: hostapd_set_bss_options
methods.description: Sets BSS-specific options for hostapd including security, rates, and other parameters.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_teardown_interface
methods.description: Removes WPA supplicant interface configuration and related files.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_prepare_interface
methods.description: Prepares WPA supplicant configuration for a network interface.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_set_fixed_freq
methods.description: Sets fixed frequency and channel width parameters for WPA supplicant network.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_add_network
methods.description: Adds a network block to WPA supplicant configuration with detailed parameters.
